description: Repositories discovered to hold latent value and promoted into the ranked build-out tier.

repos.value_thesis: Zero-dependency cross-channel content-rendering engine + platform quality gate (char limits, hashtag caps, unresolved-var/link checks) + registry loader. Already live with a CLI, 18 templates, 101 passing tests, and a downstream consumer (ORGAN-IV). Highest leverage as an importable publishing library for every social-posting repo in the estate, not a single-consumer JSON producer.
repos.first_task: Expose kerygma_templates.render_and_check(event, channel) in __init__.py (wrapping TemplateEngine.render + QualityChecker.check over the bundled templates dir) and consume it from social-automation instead of the static template-registry.json export.
